title: Jeremy Corbell and the missing page of the Shellenberger-released government document
summary: Flying Lotus tells of Jeremy Corbell and the missing page of the Shellenberger-released government document, about 2024 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Jeremy Corbel went on that whole tangent about the the missing page and the fact that he >> his name was taken off of the whole thing and it just really rubbed me the wrong way.

plain: In 2024 a journalist named Michael Shellenberger released a government document about secret UFO knowledge. A hip hop musician known as Flying Lotus told podcast host Jesse Michels that Jeremy Corbell, a man who talks publicly about UFOs, complained that a page of the document was missing and that his own name had been taken off it. Flying Lotus says that story really bothered him, since it suggests someone was editing what the public got to see.
